title: Editorial application
slide_intent: Balance display type with sustained reading because a brand voice must work beyond short headlines.
strategic_value: A coherent headline and body system can make Lufthansa editorial material feel related to its service graphics.
demonstration: An open magazine shows a large aircraft image and bold headline beside a page of photos and small text.
practical_value: Evaluate how headline emphasis, imagery and body copy divide the editorial page.

content_islands.name: Lead spread
content_islands.spec: Keep the aircraft image and large German headline on the left.

content_islands.name: Supporting page
content_islands.spec: Retain the smaller images and text blocks on the right.
